dossier.claim: The English sometimes supplies an additional action, outcome, measurement, or instruction that the source does not state or require. These additions can be plausible and still change the account.
dossier.sourcePattern: The Japanese names efficient handling of events, a substantially older bully, a deliberately prolonged tour, withheld assistance, a probable accident, tissue necrosis, a reset sword stance, and distracted familiar cooking.
dossier.englishEffect: A new absolute prediction says Shirou will never save the people he hopes to save. A bully becomes exactly twice a girl’s age; minor sightseeing replaces counter-surveillance; and refusing assistance becomes an instruction not to hold back. Other additions specify natural causation, death, re-sheathing a sword, or looking at the sky.
dossier.limits: English can supply grammatical objects, identify an implied participant, and use figurative idioms without inventing an event. Summon one does not reveal what is summoned, and knock some sense need not describe hitting. The examples require more than an extra word: they introduce a proposition not secured by the source and its context.

findings.explanation: A comparison between these two combatants becomes a rule about Archer- and Saber-class Servants. Archer's later description of himself likewise becomes a claim about all archers' preferences; the dialogue may be rhetorical, but its scope is broader.

contexts.english: There are no archers who would prefer to fight with swords.

findings.description: An attempt to repel every sword becomes successful deflection of every sword.
findings.sourceReading: 払いのけようと marks her aim when facing the attack with mortal resolve.
findings.explanation: An attempt to repel every sword becomes successful deflection of every sword.

contexts.japanese: その全てを、手にした剣だけで払いのけようと
contexts.english: strikes down each and every sword that rains down.

findings.description: A bad matchup is inflated into the absolute worst matchup and misspelled.

findings.explanation: A bad matchup is inflated into the absolute worst matchup and misspelled.

contexts.japanese: 私と彼とでは相性が悪い
contexts.english: he is the aboslute worst match up for me.

findings.description: Rin's repeated staring acquires repeated quick looks away.

findings.explanation: Rin's repeated staring acquires repeated quick looks away.

contexts.japanese: じろじろとこっちを見たりするんだ
contexts.english: she's been looking in my direction, then quickly looking away.

findings.description: Several minutes of unexplained commotion become Rin running around in search of something.

findings.explanation: Several minutes of unexplained commotion become Rin running around in search of something.

contexts.japanese: バタバタという音が続くこと数分
contexts.english: I can hear her running around the room for something.

findings.description: Rin's intention to go to Shirou becomes an intention to find both Shirou and Saber for a discussion.

findings.explanation: Rin's intention to go to Shirou becomes an intention to find both Shirou and Saber for a discussion.

contexts.japanese: ちょうどアンタんところに行こうと思ってたところだから
contexts.english: I was just thinking about going to find you guys to talk about something.

findings.description: A counterfactual lifelong loss of face becomes a belief that he had overslept plus an imagined violent scolding.

findings.explanation: A counterfactual lifelong loss of face becomes a belief that he had overslept plus an imagined violent scolding.

contexts.japanese: うっかり寝過ごし、遠坂にたたき起こされでもしたら一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ

findings.explanation: A connective beat becomes the unsupported fragment 'Right in my face.'

contexts.japanese: と。
contexts.english: Right in my face.

findings.description: Rin's strong heart becomes a heart of steel 'who' acts at a moment's notice.

contexts.japanese: 自分の弱さをきっぱりと切り捨てる強い心
contexts.english: has the heart of steel who's willing to discard her weakness at a moment's notice.

findings.explanation: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.

contexts.japanese: もう手を繋ぐ事はないと見送った余人の記憶
contexts.english: The memory of a person who watched their loved one leave knowing she would never hold his hands again.

contexts.english: you owe me a trillion

contexts.english: her nail is digging into the tip of my nose!

findings.description: Saturday allowing an early return becomes an asserted half-day school schedule.

findings.explanation: Saturday allowing an early return becomes an asserted half-day school schedule.

findings.explanation: Kiritsugu being absent-minded and unimpressive becomes being a klutz.

contexts.japanese: 普段はぼーっとしていて、どうも冴えなかった。

findings.explanation: Saber looking directly at Shirou while speaking matter-of-factly becomes scrutinizing him.

contexts.english: I'd say she's already had her growth spurt and she's good as she is.

contexts.english: If you wanna tell everyone, then go ahead!

contexts.english: some liquid drug splashed on her.

findings.explanation: Sole responsibility for his own failure becomes being the sole person who failed to notice.

contexts.japanese: 気付かなかったのは俺だけの落ち度だ
contexts.english: I was the only person who failed to notice any of it.

contexts.japanese: 箱は冒険物の映画で出てくる宝箱そっくり
contexts.english: It's filled with treasures straight out of an adventure movie.

contexts.english: let the fragrant liquid soothe my throat.

findings.sourceReading: 唾液にまみれた舌が、乾いた唇を舐め上げる assigns moisture to tongue, dryness to lips and the action to licking the lips.
findings.explanation: A saliva-wet tongue licking dry lips becomes a dry tongue licking spittle on his chin.

contexts.japanese: 唾液にまみれた舌が、乾いた唇を舐め上げる
contexts.english: His dry tongue licks up the spittle running down his chin.

findings.description: A reported resident dragon becomes a former resident.
findings.sourceReading: 竜が棲むという reports the local tradition in the present.
findings.explanation: A reported resident dragon becomes a former resident.

contexts.japanese: 裏の池には竜が棲むという
contexts.english: the pond was once home to a dragon.

findings.description: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: そんな俺を前にして describes her reaction facing him before returning the home greeting.
findings.explanation: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.

contexts.japanese: そんな俺を前にして
contexts.english: Sakura steps in front of me.

findings.description: An abrupt departure story becomes an urgent event forcing her to leave.
findings.sourceReading: 急な話だけど comments on the sudden news before saying she went home and will not return.
findings.explanation: An abrupt departure story becomes an urgent event forcing her to leave.

contexts.japanese: 急な話だけど、あいつは帰った
contexts.english: Something urgent came up, so she had to leave.

findings.description: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.
findings.sourceReading: 熱に沈む describes being immersed in the heat affecting face, fingers and body.
findings.explanation: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.

contexts.japanese: 顔を、指を、身体を熱くする熱に沈む
contexts.english: She brings her face and hands in, trying to ball up the warmth heating her body.

findings.description: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: 奪い返した is taking back, with no expressed object or source-person in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 奪い返したという事実
contexts.english: What she took from him.

findings.description: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.
findings.sourceReading: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば imagines him being disabled as the solution but does not explicitly name who inflicts the injury.
findings.explanation: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.

contexts.japanese: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば
contexts.english: If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore

findings.description: Weight clinging to the moving ankles gains a twisting-ankle event.
findings.sourceReading: 重いモノが足枷となってまとわりつく describes fettering weight around the ankles he tries to move.
findings.explanation: Weight clinging to the moving ankles gains a twisting-ankle event.

contexts.japanese: 重いモノが足枷となってまとわりつく
contexts.english: my ankles twist, caught on something heavy like shackles.

findings.description: Not imagining forgetting even in a dream becomes especially not imagining it while inside the dream.
findings.sourceReading: 夢にも思えなかった is the idiom for never imagining the possibility, with possible literary resonance in a passage about recurring dreams.
findings.explanation: Not imagining forgetting even in a dream becomes especially not imagining it while inside the dream.

contexts.japanese: それこそ夢にも思えなかった
contexts.english: especially while I was in the dream.

findings.description: This night’s lack of a strange event with Rin becomes never having done anything that crazy with her.
findings.sourceReading: 遠坂とおかしなコトになったワケでもない denies the recent dream’s events alongside not visiting school while asleep.
findings.explanation: This night’s lack of a strange event with Rin becomes never having done anything that crazy with her.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とおかしなコトになったワケでもない
contexts.english: I've never done anything that crazy with Tohsaka.

findings.description: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.
findings.sourceReading: 手足は休息を欲しがって describes bodily exhaustion despite only going to the veranda.
findings.explanation: Limbs wanting rest after a short walk gain breathlessness as the cause of collapse.

contexts.japanese: 手足は休息を欲しがってすぐに倒れてしまう
contexts.english: the effort made me so short of breath I collapsed right back into bed.

findings.description: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.
findings.sourceReading: 駆けつけた桜に念を押される is Sakura rushing over to reinforce her verbal instruction.
findings.explanation: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.

contexts.japanese: 駆けつけた桜に念を押されてしまった
contexts.english: Sakura rushes over and pushes me down.

findings.description: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.
findings.sourceReading: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる specifies the attempted bodily restraint.
findings.explanation: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.

contexts.japanese: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる
contexts.english: The thermometer inches threateningly towards me, its holder losing her composure.

findings.description: Going out behind their backs becomes a general question about sanity.
findings.sourceReading: 私たちの目を盗んで出かける explicitly names evading their observation to leave while ill.
findings.explanation: Going out behind their backs becomes a general question about sanity.

contexts.japanese: 私たちの目を盗んで出かけるとは
contexts.english: Have you taken leave of your senses!?

findings.description: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力をぶつけただけ describes a binding from simply directing magical energy at him.
findings.explanation: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.

contexts.japanese: 魔力をぶつけただけの呪縛
contexts.english: clash our magical energies to bind you in a curse.

findings.description: A stench beyond the nose-bending idiom becomes nobody telling him about it.
findings.sourceReading: 鼻が曲がるどころの話じゃねえ intensifies how foul the smell is beyond the usual idiom.
findings.explanation: A stench beyond the nose-bending idiom becomes nobody telling him about it.

contexts.japanese: 鼻が曲がるどころの話じゃねえな
contexts.english: No one told me anything about the stench.

findings.description: A face suggesting mountain-beast life becomes established past residence.
findings.sourceReading: 山奥で獣と暮らしていた面ァ describes the look of the lurking enemy’s face, not authenticated biography.
findings.explanation: A face suggesting mountain-beast life becomes established past residence.

contexts.japanese: 山奥で獣と暮らしていた面ァしてやがる
contexts.english: it was living amongst the mountain beasts.

findings.description: Cutting at limb roots becomes severing limbs.
findings.sourceReading: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ names cuts at limb junctions and major arteries.
findings.explanation: Cutting at limb roots becomes severing limbs.

contexts.japanese: 手足の付け根、大動脈を斬りつければ
contexts.english: the severing of one's limbs or major arteries

findings.description: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.
findings.sourceReading: 四肢の無力化 is limb disablement in contrast with bleeding; the next example considers disabling a single arm.
findings.explanation: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.

contexts.japanese: これが四肢の無力化になると話は別だが
contexts.english: if one were to cripple all four limbs

findings.description: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou notices that Sakura has lowered her face for some unexplained reason, then asks whether she feels unwell.
findings.explanation: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.

contexts.japanese: なぜか、桜は俯いていた
contexts.english: Sakura is in my way.

findings.description: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.
findings.sourceReading: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります offers return only if he tells her to, while begging him to stop before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.

contexts.japanese: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります
contexts.english: I'll come home, I promise.

findings.description: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.
findings.sourceReading: 顔は熱で上気したまま and 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそう distinguish continuing facial flush from apparent fever degree.
findings.explanation: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 顔は熱で上気したままだったが、熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
contexts.english: The fever appears to have worsened, though the rest of her body doesn't feel any warmer.

findings.description: Reaching for a teacup becomes pouring warm water.
findings.sourceReading: 湯飲みに手を伸ばした identifies reaching toward the cup after sitting.
findings.explanation: Reaching for a teacup becomes pouring warm water.

contexts.japanese: 湯飲みに手を伸ばした
contexts.english: pours herself a cup of warm water.

findings.description: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.
findings.sourceReading: 我が身を振り返っちまう and 恥ずかしい say praise makes him look back at himself and feel embarrassed.
findings.explanation: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.

contexts.japanese: 我が身を振り返っちまう
contexts.english: regret everything I've ever done.

findings.description: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.
findings.sourceReading: 道場で正座したり imagines the physical formal sitting alongside riverbank running.
findings.explanation: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.

contexts.japanese: 道場で正座したり
contexts.english: meditated in the dojo.

findings.description: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.
findings.sourceReading: 何倍も intensifies anger beyond ordinary people without assigning a fixed multiplier.
findings.explanation: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.

contexts.japanese: 他のヤツより何倍も怒る
contexts.english: twice as mad

findings.description: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方とて判っている筈 says he should understand the evident reason she is about to explain.
findings.explanation: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.

contexts.japanese: 貴方とて判っている筈
contexts.english: Surely, you must feel the same way.

findings.description: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.
findings.sourceReading: He fears next-door witnesses despising what they are doing in broad daylight.
findings.explanation: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.

contexts.japanese: 昼間っから何してるんだって軽蔑される
contexts.english: the next time we're in the living room.

findings.description: Limited Western-sweets competence becomes broader Western-food competence.
findings.sourceReading: 洋菓子 singles out sweets, with pancakes about the one thing he can manage.
findings.explanation: Limited Western-sweets competence becomes broader Western-food competence.

contexts.japanese: 洋菓子は……そうだな、ホットケーキぐらいなら、なんとか
contexts.english: As for Western food... I can manage pancakes and stuff.

findings.description: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.
findings.sourceReading: キチンとした qualifies the activation spell; deliberate intent allows remembering it, with no speed specification.
findings.explanation: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.

contexts.japanese: キチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる
contexts.english: you can instantly recall his incantations

findings.description: Absentminded cooking becomes looking up at the sky.
findings.sourceReading: 上の空 means distracted, while familiar movements are automatic.
findings.explanation: Absentminded cooking becomes looking up at the sky.

contexts.japanese: 上の空でやってのける
contexts.english: so I start looking up at the sky.

findings.description: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.
findings.sourceReading: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ concerns prior behavior as Shirou understood it.
findings.explanation: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.

contexts.japanese: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ
contexts.english: It didn't need to murder them like this.

findings.description: Keeping her head lowered becomes sulking.
findings.sourceReading: 俯いたまま specifies posture while she trembles at her own words; the narrator cannot identify the cause.
findings.explanation: Keeping her head lowered becomes sulking.

contexts.japanese: 俯いたまま、自分の言葉に身を震わせている
contexts.english: She's sulking, shaking at her own words.

findings.description: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.
findings.sourceReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

contexts.japanese: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
contexts.english: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!

findings.description: Speaking while eating stinging tofu becomes speaking before a face-making reaction.
findings.sourceReading: 食べながら connects her remark with eating and the tofu stings her tongue.
findings.explanation: Speaking while eating stinging tofu becomes speaking before a face-making reaction.

contexts.japanese: 舌がヒリヒリする麻婆豆腐を食べながら
contexts.english: before making a face as the mapo tofu tingles her tongue.

findings.description: Not questioning existing separate upbringing becomes certainty of future casting-off.
findings.sourceReading: He did not question why she was being raised separately from him, given one-heir teaching.
findings.explanation: Not questioning existing separate upbringing becomes certainty of future casting-off.

contexts.japanese: 自分と切り離されて育てられている事に疑問をもたなかった
contexts.english: never had any doubts that his sister would be cast off and raised separately.

findings.description: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.
findings.sourceReading: あなたの家だと笑う identifies the surprising happy behavior there without exclusive location.
findings.explanation: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.

contexts.japanese: あなたの家だと笑う
contexts.english: She only smiles when she's at your place.

findings.description: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.
findings.sourceReading: 聞いていよう presumes his knowledge before recounting the end.
findings.explanation: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.

contexts.japanese: 十年前の聖杯戦争の終わりは聞いていよう
contexts.english: Let me ask you something about the end of the war ten years ago.

findings.description: An experiment leading to the next step becomes greater results in the next war.
findings.sourceReading: 次に繋げる does not identify the next war as the target event.
findings.explanation: An experiment leading to the next step becomes greater results in the next war.

contexts.japanese: 次に繋げる実験にすぎぬ
contexts.english: will allow greater results in the next war.

findings.description: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.
findings.sourceReading: 呑み込んでしまいかねん is a feared possibility if current course continues.
findings.explanation: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.

contexts.japanese: 呑み込んでしまいかねん
contexts.english: is bent on devouring every person in this city.

findings.description: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を原型にし assigns Sakura as prototype; こちら側での存在を象った says it shapes existence here.
findings.explanation: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.

contexts.japanese: こちら側での存在を象ったモノにすぎぬ
contexts.english: It has merely modeled itself after the creatures on this side.

findings.description: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.
findings.sourceReading: 台所から持ち出した modifies the knife he takes in hand before leaving his own room.
findings.explanation: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.

contexts.japanese: 台所から持ち出したナイフを手にして、部屋を後にした
contexts.english: I pick up a knife from the kitchen counter and leave the room.

findings.description: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.
findings.sourceReading: それを防げなかった人間 includes the preventers whose failure also wounds them, contrasted with actual victims in the prior clause.
findings.explanation: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.

contexts.japanese: それを防げなかった人間も
contexts.english: Innocent people, unable to resist.

findings.description: A screwdriver protruding from the ground becomes bouncing up.
findings.sourceReading: 地面から飛び出していた describes an already projecting obstacle into which he imagines falling.
findings.explanation: A screwdriver protruding from the ground becomes bouncing up.

contexts.japanese: 地面から飛び出していたマイナスドライバー
contexts.english: a flathead screwdriver that happened to be bouncing up

findings.description: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.
findings.sourceReading: 私情 contrasts with Kiritsugu discarding personal feelings; it does not specify gratification as the motive.
findings.explanation: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.

contexts.japanese: 私情だけで誰かを助ける無力な人間
contexts.english: A powerless human who saves others only for his own satisfaction.

findings.description: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.
findings.sourceReading: 信じ、支えてきたモノ concerns what he has believed and supported, in the abandonment of his own prior self.
findings.explanation: Things he believed and upheld become everyone who helped him.

contexts.japanese: 今まで信じ、支えてきたモノをなくして
contexts.english: leaving everything I've believed in, everyone who's helped me.

findings.description: Losing out by not resting becomes necessarily getting sicker.
findings.sourceReading: 休まないと損 plays into the joke that later she will regret not taking rest before he gives her all meals.
findings.explanation: Losing out by not resting becomes necessarily getting sicker.

contexts.japanese: 病人は病人らしく休まないと損だぞ
contexts.english: When a sick person doesn't rest, they'll just get sicker.

findings.description: A deliberate question without turning becomes a newly occurring thought.
findings.sourceReading: He puts his hand on the knob and speaks without looking back, managing his natural delivery before asking about collapse.
findings.explanation: A deliberate question without turning becomes a newly occurring thought.

contexts.japanese: 振り向かずに声をあげる
contexts.english: something occurs to me.

findings.description: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.
findings.sourceReading: The correction says the activating switch itself would be outside, not that extraction prevents activation.
findings.explanation: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.

contexts.japanese: 入ってしまうスイッチそのものが外に出る
contexts.english: I need to get the fuse itself out of my head, too.

findings.description: One chance sighting becomes repeated sightings.
findings.sourceReading: たまたま a nonmember came while she regularly watched the club; seeing his face then triggers recognition.
findings.explanation: One chance sighting becomes repeated sightings.

contexts.japanese: たまたまね、部員でもないのにやってきたヤツがいて
contexts.english: sometimes, I saw this guy there that wasn't even part of the club.

findings.description: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.
findings.sourceReading: 肯定と同じ is her equation of nonintervention with affirmation.
findings.explanation: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.

contexts.japanese: それは肯定と同じだと思う
contexts.english: that means they wanted it to happen.

findings.description: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.
findings.sourceReading: いまあげられた refers to the listed Saber/Lancer/Caster/Berserker in speech.
findings.explanation: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.

contexts.japanese: いまあげられた以外のサーヴァント
contexts.english: Servants other than the ones she was given

findings.description: Contrasting a manufactured vessel with an imitation gains looking down at Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Narration contrasts Illya’s purpose-built existence with Sakura/まがいもの ruby, before declaring death.
findings.explanation: Contrasting a manufactured vessel with an imitation gains looking down at Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 初めから器として作られた少女
contexts.english: looks down at the imitation before her.

findings.description: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.
findings.sourceReading: そういう風に作られた explains her being a Grail homunculus rather than originally human.
findings.explanation: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.

contexts.japanese: そういう風に作られたホムンクルス
contexts.english: I'm just a homunculus made to look human.

findings.description: Unconventional birth becomes disreputable methods.
findings.sourceReading: まっとうな手段 contrasts normal birth with artificial magical creation.
findings.explanation: Unconventional birth becomes disreputable methods.

contexts.japanese: まっとうな手段によって生まれ得なかった
contexts.english: Born from less than respectable methods

findings.description: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.
findings.sourceReading: わたし marks the speaker of said; its content is Sakura cannot be saved.
findings.explanation: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.

contexts.japanese: わたし、サクラはもう助からないって言ったのよ
contexts.english: I said that I'm beyond saving, just like Sakura, you know.

findings.description: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.
findings.sourceReading: これといってない says nothing specific she wants after thinking.
findings.explanation: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.

contexts.japanese: なんか、これといってないみたいです
contexts.english: I don't think I've ever said this before, actually.

findings.description: Modest wish gains a grateful tone.
findings.sourceReading: ささやかな願い states modest scale, without gratitude manner here.
findings.explanation: Modest wish gains a grateful tone.

contexts.japanese: ささやかな願いを口にした
contexts.english: She voices a modest wish in a grateful tone.

findings.description: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.
findings.sourceReading: 殺意 means intent to kill, not relish or lust for blood, explicitly hollow yet painful.
findings.explanation: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.

contexts.japanese: その殺意は空っぽだった
contexts.english: it was an empty bloodlust.

findings.description: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.
findings.sourceReading: 少女の罪 and この先少女が犯す罪 both hers, shared acceptance by his arms.
findings.explanation: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.

contexts.japanese: 少女の罪も、この先少女が犯す罪も、全部一緒になって受ける
contexts.english: he would combine their sins and face the consequences together.

findings.description: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.
findings.sourceReading: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまった asks how their shared condition came about.
findings.explanation: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.

contexts.japanese: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまったのだろう
contexts.english: Why did she do this to him?

findings.description: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.
findings.sourceReading: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない is conditional agreement based on usefulness.
findings.explanation: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない
contexts.english: it's the only way to defeat Zouken.

findings.description: Rewrapping ability gains removing it himself.
findings.sourceReading: 巻き直せる is rewrapping, allowing recovery from accidental loosening; full removal remains forbidden.
findings.explanation: Rewrapping ability gains removing it himself.

contexts.japanese: せめて自分で巻き直せるぐらい
contexts.english: at least take it off and put it back on yourself.

findings.description: Shirou’s agreement conditions her help becomes Illya’s prior promise.
findings.sourceReading: シロウが約束したのなら is if Shirou agreed/promised, despite her opposition.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s agreement conditions her help becomes Illya’s prior promise.

contexts.japanese: シロウが約束したのなら手伝ってあげる
contexts.english: But I did promise to help you.

findings.description: Apparently roughness is okay gains with cooking.
findings.sourceReading: あと、乱暴でもいいらしい is an incongruous extra remark, met by you’re-really-half-asleep.
findings.explanation: Apparently roughness is okay gains with cooking.

contexts.japanese: あと、乱暴でもいいらしいんだ
contexts.english: It's okay to be a bit rough with cooking.

findings.description: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.
findings.sourceReading: いまから食材を begins a prospective action concerning ingredients, left incomplete;11 recalls shopping decision.
findings.explanation: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.

contexts.japanese: いまから食材を
contexts.english: why are we talking about food

findings.description: Remembering the decision becomes claiming he only wanted to double-check.
findings.sourceReading: He recalls forgotten stew decision and says if decided, that makes it clear.
findings.explanation: Remembering the decision becomes claiming he only wanted to double-check.

contexts.japanese: ま、決まってるならハッキリしてていい。

findings.description: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks whether a criminal's son is certain to become a criminal, making prenatal killing the consequence of that prediction.
findings.explanation: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.

contexts.japanese: それともなにか？　おまえは犯罪者の息子は間違いなく犯罪者になるとでも言うのか？　それ故に、生まれる前に殺してしまえと？」
contexts.english: Or are you saying that you would condemn the child of a criminal and accuse it of the same crimes? Would you execute it before it is even born?"

findings.description: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

contexts.japanese: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
contexts.english: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.

findings.description: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.
findings.sourceReading: He loved humans reaching higher/farther/broader, endlessly opening limits; made self evil for their sake.
findings.explanation: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.

contexts.japanese: より高く、より遠く、より広く。際限なく限界を切り開く人間を愛し、その為に、自身を絶対の悪とした。
contexts.english: His love for humanity was higher, further, and broader than any other. That is why he turned himself into absolute evil.

findings.description: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.
findings.sourceReading: Upon acceptance current terribly suffering body becomes miraculously easy.
findings.explanation: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.

contexts.japanese: ただ、受け入れた途端、あれだけ苦しかった体が嘘のように楽になった。
contexts.english: All she knows is that the moment she accepted her shadow, all the pain she'd ever felt vanished like a dream.

findings.description: Darkening vision becomes an invented question about whether only vision is darkening.
findings.sourceReading: Within his darkening vision is a setting fragment following inability to keep consciousness.
findings.explanation: Darkening vision becomes an invented question about whether only vision is darkening.

contexts.japanese: 暗くなっていく視界のなか。
contexts.english: Is it just my vision that's going dark?

findings.description: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura made plenty and encourages Shirou to eat a lot.
findings.explanation: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.

contexts.japanese: 「はい、御代わりですね！　いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
contexts.english: "Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"

findings.description: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
contexts.english: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.

findings.description: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing the fight is also atonement toward Saber, whom Shirou understands to have died after going along with his selfishness.
findings.explanation: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.

contexts.japanese: ……それが俺の我が侭につき合い、命を落としたセイバーへの償いでもある。
contexts.english: ...It's the only way I can repay Saber for going along with my selfishness.

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.
findings.sourceReading: Body stumbles over dark longing, falls immediately and abjectly clings to ground.
findings.explanation: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.

contexts.japanese: 体は昏い恋しさに躓いてすぐに倒れ、卑しく地面にすがりつく。
contexts.english: The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.

findings.description: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.
findings.sourceReading: Today, no person whatsoever will return alive; imagined trees voice an absolute warning.
findings.explanation: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.

contexts.japanese: —今日だけは、何人たりとも生きては帰れん。
contexts.english: No matter how many people you bring, none will return alive.

contexts.japanese: 風で揺れる木々が、そう囁いている気さえする。
contexts.english: Even the trees seem to whisper that as their branches sway in the wind.

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.
findings.sourceReading: The sword paints Berserker's flank black like light swallowed by lightless darkness.
findings.explanation: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.

contexts.japanese: 無明の闇が光を呑むように、剣はバーサーカーの横腹を黒で塗りつぶしていった。
contexts.english: A sword paints Berserker's flank in black, the inky light threatening to swallow him whole.

findings.description: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.
findings.sourceReading: Berserker charges while scattering the black Shadow in which he is sunk to his knees.
findings.explanation: Charging through the knee-deep Shadow becomes already free of it after waist-deep engulfment.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーは地面を、膝まで沈みこんだ黒い影を蹴散らしながら突進する。
contexts.english: Berserker kicks his way out of the ground, free of the black Shadow that had swallowed him up to the waist, and charges.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーを封じているのは足元の沼だけでなく、黒い影は全身に絡みついて巨人を縛している。
contexts.english: Not only was he being constricted by the mud at his feet. The Shadow also had him entirely bound.

contexts.japanese: 故に、巨人はその身を裂いた。
contexts.english: So he decided to tear himself free.

findings.description: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Illya vaguely realizes escape from her fear is impossible, and the narration then states that Berserker stops.
findings.explanation: The English adds an order from Illya where the Japanese simply says Berserker stops. It makes her direct the halt, although the source leaves its immediate cause unstated.

contexts.japanese: この不安、恐怖からは逃げられない、と少女は漠然と悟り—黒い巨人は足を止めた。
contexts.english: Vaguely realizing that there's no escape from this dread, from this fear, the girl orders the dark giant to stop.

findings.description: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.
findings.sourceReading: Illya mocks Zouken as 当事者, one directly involved/concerned with the arrangement, for forgetting it.
findings.explanation: A party to the ritual becomes a founder.

contexts.japanese: —ま、当事者である貴方がソレを忘れるぐらいだから、マキリの血は衰退したんでしょうけど」
contexts.english: ...The Makiri bloodline really must have fallen into ruin, if even a founder has forgotten that."

findings.description: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.
findings.sourceReading: The Shadow mercilessly swallows prey caught in a spiderweb-like situation; metaphor does not enumerate victims.
findings.explanation: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.

contexts.japanese: 蜘蛛の巣にかかった獲物を、容赦なく呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: swallowing every last prey within its web.

findings.description: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei provocatively equates causing/allowing life with fulfilling desire, leaving the desire's owner and moral implication open.
findings.explanation: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.

contexts.japanese: 生かすという事は欲望を満たすという事。
contexts.english: Letting her live is an act of greed.

findings.description: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers cooperation until their shared objective of defeating Zouken is achieved.
findings.explanation: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.

contexts.japanese: だいたいね、貴方だけじゃ心許ないでしょ。臓硯を倒すって目的は一緒なんだし、それまで手を組んであげてもいいってコト！」
contexts.english: I bet you aren't feeling great about fighting alone, either. We both want to take down Zouken, so I'll team up with you if that's what you want!"

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ、協力してあげてもいいって言ってるのっ！
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

findings.description: The English adds disembowelment to the apparent corpse while retaining uncertainty through 'looks like.' This supports a separate finding about added gore, not a claim about Saber's motives.
findings.sourceReading: Something resembling Berserker's corpse is sinking into the Shadow.
findings.explanation: The English adds disembowelment to the apparent corpse while retaining uncertainty through 'looks like.' This supports a separate finding about added gore, not a claim about Saber's motives.

contexts.japanese: 目の前に剣を突きつけられ、セイバーの背後では、バーサーカーの亡骸らしきものが、黒い影に沈んでいた。
contexts.english: Behind Saber, something that looks like the eviscerated corpse of Berserker sinks into the dark Shadow.

findings.description: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
findings.sourceReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.

contexts.japanese: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
contexts.english: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"

findings.description: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou orders himself that an arm not moving is nothing serious and to think about something else.
findings.explanation: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.

contexts.japanese: 「……大丈夫だ。ただ腕が動かないだけで、どうって事はない。悩むならもっと別のことを考えろ」
contexts.english: "...It'll be okay. I can't move the arm, but I still have options. There's plenty of other stuff to worry about."

findings.description: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says those two years themselves were happiness for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.

contexts.japanese: サクラにとっては、この二年間こそが幸福だった」
contexts.english: these last two years have been the happiest times of her life."

findings.description: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.
findings.sourceReading: Forcibly breaking visual sharing leaves Sakura's sight clouded white as if blind.
findings.explanation: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントと共有していた視覚を強引に断った為、視界は失明したかのように白濁としている。
contexts.english: She's hit by the vertigo of suddenly severing her senses from that of her Servant.

findings.description: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine tells Illya to leave the room if she has no business there.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.

contexts.japanese: 「あちらも持ち直した。こちらは事後説明だけだからな、用がなければ退室したまえ」
contexts.english: "She's recovering as well. I'm only going to debrief him, so if you don't have any business here, go wait in the lobby."

findings.description: A quotation-reporting connective becomes Shirou saying 'Huh.'
findings.sourceReading: The fragment と closes/reports Illya's odd reply before narration comments on it; it is not a spoken reaction.
findings.explanation: A quotation-reporting connective becomes Shirou saying 'Huh.'

contexts.japanese: と。
contexts.english: Huh.

findings.description: Kirei having no wish becomes never having any desires in his life.
findings.sourceReading: The narration affirms that Kirei has no wish of the kind the Grail would grant; what he has is relentless inquiry.
findings.explanation: Kirei having no wish becomes never having any desires in his life.

contexts.japanese: 金髪の青年には理解できぬだけで、もとよりこの男に望みなどないのだ。
contexts.english: The blond man simply doesn't understand that the priest never had any desires in his life at all.

findings.description: Meeting paternal expectations becomes merely appeasing them.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei's inability to love his father and his fulfillment of his father's expectations are separate matters.
findings.explanation: Meeting paternal expectations becomes merely appeasing them.

contexts.japanese: 父を愛せない事と、父の期待に応える事は別の問題だ。
contexts.english: That he could not love his father and was only appeasing his expectations was a separate matter.

findings.description: The Grail trying to exist becomes Kirei wanting to let it exist.
findings.sourceReading: Ten years earlier he pursued the Grail because it itself was trying to come into existence/birth.
findings.explanation: The Grail trying to exist becomes Kirei wanting to let it exist.

contexts.japanese: 十年前聖杯を求めたのも、聖杯が在ろうとしたからだ。
contexts.english: Ten years ago, I sought it out because I wanted to let it exist as it is.

findings.description: An unknown nobody becomes a knight of unknown lineage.
findings.sourceReading: 馬の骨 is a contemptuous nobody of unknown origin whom a noble house would admit.
findings.explanation: An unknown nobody becomes a knight of unknown lineage.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を手に入れた暁には、衛宮切嗣は正式にアインツベルンの人間として迎えられた筈だ。何処の出とも判らない馬の骨を貴族に迎え入れるようなものでな。
contexts.english: If Kiritsugu Emiya had given the Einzberns the Holy Grail, they would have taken him in as an official member of their family. Not unlike a noble family taking in a knight of unknown lineage and origins.

findings.description: A causal explanation is invented after Kirei calls Kiritsugu the clearest evil.
findings.sourceReading: If ruthlessness constitutes evil, Kirei says no one in the previous war was a more obvious evil than Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: A causal explanation is invented after Kirei calls Kiritsugu the clearest evil.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。もし今回の戦いに切嗣がいるのなら、おまえが最も嫌悪するマスターになっただろう。非情だという事が悪になるのなら、前回の戦いで最も判りやすい悪は、あの男をおいて他にはなかったのだから」
contexts.english: "Let me put it another way. If Kiritsugu was part of this war, he would be the worst possible Master for you to face. If you consider ruthlessness a form of evil, then he would have been the most obvious source of evil in the last war. He had nothing else, after all."

findings.description: Sacrifices to be ignored become excess and hypocrisy.
findings.sourceReading: In Kiritsugu's too-simple design, the surplus parts that do not fit its perfect shape are sacrifices; the text overlays disposing of them with ignoring them.
findings.explanation: Sacrifices to be ignored become excess and hypocrisy.

contexts.japanese: 「判らずともいい。ただ衛宮切嗣の願いは“平和”だった。実にシンプルだろう。シンプルすぎるが故に、複雑な世の中ではパーツが余ってしまう。その完璧な形に入りきれない余分は処分するしかない」
contexts.english: "You don't have to understand. Kiritsugu Emiya's wish was, in a word, 'peace.' Very simple, isn't it? So simple, in fact, that in a complex world it renders much unneeded. All he could do was dispose of or ignore all the excess and hypocrisy that didn't fit into his perfect ideal."

findings.description: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says racial classification would be ridiculous if the Tohsakas' grandmaster is as reported. The passage identifies a grandmaster relationship, not biological descent from him.
findings.explanation: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.

contexts.japanese: 始まりの御三家、私やおまえでは太刀打ちできぬ歴史と血筋を誇る者たちがそれだ。この中で土着の者は遠坂だけだが、遠坂とて大師父はかの時の翁だ。尤も、遠坂の大師父が伝え聞く通りの人物ならば、人種分けなど滑稽だが」
contexts.english: The three founding families boast history and bloodlines the likes of which you and I can only dream of. Of them only the Tohsakas are natives of this land, but their grandmaster is the famed Schweinorg. If he is truly as capable as the stories say, then it is little wonder that their excellence has persisted in spite of mixed ancestry."

findings.description: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei invokes the old age when atrocities could pass under the banner of reclaiming the Holy Land, then says Einzbern's unbroken medieval persistence exceeds the human domain.
findings.explanation: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.

contexts.japanese: 一千年だぞ？　聖地奪還という使命を盾に殺して殺して殺し尽くすなどという異次元の蛮行がまかり通った昔、中世より連綿と続いた、人の領域など逸脱した狂気の沙汰だ。
contexts.english: One thousand years. In the name of their quest, they have killed and killed and killed, committing atrocities beyond imagination, clinging to their inhuman madness since the Middle Ages.

findings.description: A historically inherited tie becomes the sins of the father.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou and Einzbern stand under that inherited因縁: the charged connection produced by Kiritsugu's betrayal.
findings.explanation: A historically inherited tie becomes the sins of the father.

contexts.japanese: おまえとアインツベルンは、そういう因縁の下にある」
contexts.english: And the sins of the father underpin your relationship with them."

findings.description: A thin trickle of blood becomes the actions biting and sucking.
findings.sourceReading: After Rider's mouth is placed at the neck, つう、と depicts the thin red stream trickling down.
findings.explanation: A thin trickle of blood becomes the actions biting and sucking.

contexts.japanese: つう、と。
contexts.english: Biting. Sucking.

findings.description: Saber's decision not to pursue Shinji gains a for-my-sake motive.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou supposes she judged there was no need to pursue Shinji now that he was no longer a Master.
findings.explanation: Saber's decision not to pursue Shinji gains a for-my-sake motive.

contexts.japanese: マスターでなくなった慎二を追う必要はない、と考えてくれたのだろう。
contexts.english: She's probably decided—for my sake—that Shinji isn't worth pursuing now that he's no longer a Master.

findings.description: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken recalls that leadership had passed from that man to the young girl; the split Japanese line completes 代替わりしたのであったな.
findings.explanation: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.

contexts.japanese: おお、たしか彼奴から小娘に代替わりしたのであっ
contexts.english: Ah, yes. They let us adopt one of their

contexts.japanese: たな。
contexts.english: daughters, once.

findings.description: An inborn-inferiority obsession becomes something Shinji was taught.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says Shinji grew up simultaneously arrogant that he was chosen and compulsively convinced he was inferior by birth.
findings.explanation: An inborn-inferiority obsession becomes something Shinji was taught.

contexts.japanese: 「……まったく、だというのに何処で秘伝を紐解いたのか。アレは選ばれた人間などという驕りを持ちながら、同時に生まれつき劣っているという強迫観念を持って育ちおった。
contexts.english: "...By jove, where did he even learn of such secrets? His head is filled with conceits of being a chosen one, even as he grapples with the inferiority complex of being taught how flawed he was from birth.

findings.description: A stunned fixed stare becomes a laser-hot glare.
findings.sourceReading: Fuji-nee and Sakura are taken aback and stare steadily at Shirou after the lodging announcement.
findings.explanation: A stunned fixed stare becomes a laser-hot glare.

contexts.japanese: 当然と言えば当然、予想通り藤ねえと桜は面食らってこっちをじーーーーーっと見つめてくる。
contexts.english: As I expected, Fuji-nee and Sakura take one look at Saber and then fix me with a laser-hot glare.

findings.description: Shirou's admired model-student image becomes romantic fantasy and school-idol fixation.
findings.sourceReading: He jokes that the proud model student of their school died last night—in his own mind—and that 'model student Rin Tohsaka' has vanished from him.
findings.explanation: Shirou's admired model-student image becomes romantic fantasy and school-idol fixation.

contexts.japanese: 我が校の誇る優等生は昨夜死んだ。
contexts.english: Whatever fantasies I had of Tohsaka died last night.

contexts.japanese: まことに遺憾だが、優等生遠坂凛は俺の中から消え去ってしまったのだこんちくしょう。
contexts.english: To my deep regret, Rin Tohsaka, the star student and idol of my high school life, was wiped away yesterday. Damn it.

findings.description: Kirei admitting an unnecessary talk becomes saying he simply told Shirou not to worry.

findings.explanation: Kirei admitting an unnecessary talk becomes saying he simply told Shirou not to worry.

contexts.english: "Oh, I simply told you not to worry. After all, I'd be a failure of a priest if I added to my flock's troubles, instead of lifting them away."

findings.description: The beauty of a cold, taut winter sky becomes a frozen-lake simile.
findings.sourceReading: The winter stars are cold and tensely clear, and beautiful precisely because of that quality.
findings.explanation: The beauty of a cold, taut winter sky becomes a frozen-lake simile.

contexts.japanese: 冬の星空は冷たく張り詰めて、だからこそ綺麗だった。
contexts.english: The starry winter sky reminds me of a frozen lake. It's so beautiful.

findings.description: Being cut becomes being cut in half.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou protests that Saber would have been cut if he had not intervened.
findings.explanation: Being cut becomes being cut in half.
